lines_read_unit: nonblank checked source lines excluding comments and scan markers
visual_notes: Both supplied images read completely, once for the overlap, including every prose line, formula, nested index, punctuation mark, and all margins. No source-reading change was required; unusual typed placements and both translator queries were retained with French-site references. A further paired-glyph placement review retained the observed Greek subscript shifts and corrected six P/v groups; each amendment has its own superseding decision.
